element.text: Porting a number requires the donor operator's PIC

clause:
## Number porting
Porting a number requires the donor operator's PIC. If the port-in request
failed, the number stays with the donor operator; do not tell the user the
number has moved.

element.text: Escalation to a human agent is allowed only after two failed resolution attempts in the current session

clause:

element.text: A tariff can be changed only once per billing period

clause:
## Tariff changes
A tariff can be changed only once per billing period. Changing to the "Premium"
tariff requires the user to confirm the new monthly fee in writing (in chat).
